      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes `TxIndex::FindTx` and `TxIndex::FindLegacyTx` in `src/index/txindex.cpp` (+37/-17) to throw on disk read and index corruption errors.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents txindex from silently returning 'transaction not found' when encountering disk I/O errors or index corruption. Commit e0b20465bb notes that 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception', upholding the category's priority on data integrity over silent bad answers."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` error handling and block availability checking.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents `getrawtransaction` from falsely reporting confirmed transactions as missing when underlying disk reads fail or blocks are pruned. Correctness of returned interface data directly protects downstream applications from acting on incorrect transaction existence checks."
    },
